values.note: No overnight camping since Hurricane Helene's flood (Sept 2024); the park is open for day use. Giles County is rebuilding the campground's electric, water and sewer systems with FEMA money (engineering RFP issued 2026-10-07).

status.source: https://www.wdbj7.com/2026/09/10/giles-county-rebuild-glen-lyn-park-nearly-two-years-after-hurricane-helene/ (WDBJ 2026-09-10, quoting Giles County emergency services coordinator Jon Butler: 'Right now it's open to daytime activities... but there's no overnight camping right now. We hope when we rebuild to get this back to the way it was prior to the storm - a full-service RV campground'; 'the county aims to complete the project by 2028') + Giles County's own RFP https://virginiasmtnplayground.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RFP-Glen-Lyn-Park-Campground-infrastructure-Engineering.pdf ('design of repair and improvement of electrical, water distribution and sewage collection systems at the Glen Lyn Park/Campground', flood damage from Hurricane Helene), read 2026-10-21

note: Giles County park on the New River, on Corps of Engineers land leased to the county; the Town of Glen Lyn ran it until the town dissolved in 2024. RV sites on gravel/grass plus primitive and electric tent sites, bathhouse, boat ramp. Many sites have river views. --Claude
summary: Temporarily closed: no overnight camping since Hurricane Helene (Sept 2024), county targets 2028 for the rebuild (WDBJ quoting the county; the county's 2026-10-07 engineering RFP confirms the electric/water/sewer repair). Hookups/season/FCFS (pre-storm, from the note) left as recorded; no county page states them. Note: dropped the hookup/FCFS/season text now in fields and the dissolved town's office.
flags: Temporarily closed (status written with method reported: the closure statement is a news report quoting Giles County's emergency services coordinator; the county's own pages only show the repair RFP). Re-check around 2028.

Name: the Town of Glen Lyn dissolved in 2024 and Giles County now runs it; the county calls it 'Glen Lyn Park and Campground' (https://virginiasmtnplayground.com/rfp-engineering-services-glen-lyn-park-and-campground/). Suggest renaming from 'Glen Lyn Town Park'.

Phone 540-726-7075 is the former town's number (town dissolved 2024); the county's number is Giles County Administration (540) 921-2525 (https://virginiasmtnplayground.com/parks-and-recreation/; also the RFP contact).
Missing website: Giles County's parks page https://virginiasmtnplayground.com/parks-and-recreation/ (lists Glen Lyn Park: 'They also offer camping, fishing, a boat ramp...').

Ownership: the RFP says 'The Park is owned by the United States Army Corps of Engineers and is leased to the County of Giles.' Entry is `local`; the county operates it, so `local` looks right - noted for the record only.
